import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas.io.stata as _stata_mod
from pandas import Series

conv = getattr(_stata_mod, "_stata_elapsed_date_to_datetime_vec", None)

cases = [
    ("tm_int8_neg100", Series([-100], dtype="int8"), "%tm"),
    ("ty_int8_100", Series([100], dtype="int8"), "%ty"),
    ("td_neg1e19", Series([-1e19]), "%td"),
    ("tc_2pow63", Series([2.0 ** 63]), "%tc"),
    ("tm_1e13", Series([1e13]), "%tm"),
    ("tc_1e9_nan", Series([1e9, np.nan]), "%tc"),
]

if conv is None:
    probe("converter_missing", "pandas.io.stata has no _stata_elapsed_date_to_datetime_vec")
else:
    for name, ser, fmt in cases:
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
            warnings.simplefilter("always")
            try:
                out = conv(ser, fmt)
                desc = "dtype=%s values=%s" % (out.dtype, [str(v) for v in out])
            except Exception as exc:
                desc = "RAISED %s: %s" % (type(exc).__name__, exc)
        probe(name, desc)
        probe(name + "_warnings", [str(w.message) for w in caught])
